questions.question: What is the difference between var, let and const, and which do you reach for by default?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you understand scoping and hoisting, and that const does not make an object immutable.

questions.question: Explain what happens when JavaScript hits an await. Does it block the page?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you understand the event loop - that await yields rather than blocking the single thread.

questions.question: Why use a <button> instead of a <div> with a click handler?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you think about keyboard users and screen readers, not just what looks right visually.

questions.question: An element is wider than you expected. How do you work out why?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you know the box model and box-sizing, and that you debug in the browser rather than guessing.

questions.question: When would you use flexbox rather than grid?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you see them as one-dimensional versus two-dimensional tools, rather than interchangeable.

questions.question: How do you make a layout work on a 320px phone and a wide desktop?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you design mobile-first with relative units, rather than bolting on breakpoints afterwards.

questions.question: What is the difference between state and props, and how do you decide where state should live?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you understand one-way data flow and lifting state to the nearest common ancestor.

questions.question: What goes wrong if you omit the dependency array in useEffect?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you have actually debugged a render loop, rather than only read about hooks.

questions.question: Why does React want a key on list items, and why is the array index usually a poor choice?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you understand reconciliation and what breaks when list order changes.

questions.question: Your project works in JavaScript. What does TypeScript add that is worth the extra effort?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you can argue a tooling decision on its merits, including the costs.
